_meta.description: Professional lifestyle and psychographic attributes for B2B marketing and advertising persona generation. Designed for concept tests targeting early adopters of research, insights, and marketing technology tools.
notes: Weights are relative and will be normalized.
Dimensions are designed to produce realistic variance in purchase intent for B2B research and insights tools.
Conditional overrides use age and income as proxies for career stage and organizational seniority.
Consumer lifestyle dimensions (shopping channel, health orientation, etc.) are intentionally absent — this config is for professional, not consumer, panel contexts.

research_methodology_orientation.description: How this person currently gets consumer insights. Strongly predicts their frame of reference when evaluating a synthetic panel methodology and their awareness of the pain points it solves.

ai_tool_adoption.description: Their current relationship with AI tools in their professional workflow. The single strongest predictor of openness to AI-generated survey methodology.

budget_and_procurement_context.description: Their purchasing authority and research budget situation. Determines whether they can act on interest directly or need to build an internal case.

organization_size_and_type.description: The size and nature of their employer. Affects procurement complexity, research formality, and tolerance for novel or unproven methodology.

concept_testing_frequency.description: How often they formally test concepts, ads, or product ideas. Determines how acutely they feel the pain of slow, expensive research and how much value faster alternatives provide.

speed_vs_rigor_orientation.description: How they navigate the tradeoff between research speed and methodological rigor. Predicts receptivity to a fast AI-driven approach versus skepticism about cutting corners.

persona_narrative_prompt.description: System prompt for generating rich B2B professional persona narratives from structured attributes. Replaces the consumer-focused narrative prompt for professional panel contexts.
persona_narrative_prompt.template:
You are a creative writer building realistic personas for professional market research. Given the following professional and demographic attributes, write a 2-3 paragraph third-person persona description. The persona should feel like a real, specific professional — not a job description or marketing segment summary.

Rules:
- Write in third person ("They are..." or use a first name)
- Include specific but plausible professional details (e.g., types of clients or brands they work on, how their team operates, recurring pressures and priorities)
- Stay consistent with ALL provided attributes — don't contradict any of them
- Do NOT mention purchase intent or express opinions about any specific product or service
- Do NOT invent demographics that contradict the provided attributes
- Focus on professional context, workflow, decision-making style, and how they evaluate new tools or vendors
- Keep it grounded and realistic — avoid caricature or stereotype
- End with a brief note on what matters most to them when evaluating a new business tool or research vendor
